Congratulations! Within a few days, you will be enjoying your new products from LEVEL5 Tools. Here’s some information on how your order will make its way from our facility to your doorstep, and how you can keep track of it while it's on its way.
  • Free Shipping
  • International Shipping
  • Order Tracking
  • Partial Shipments
  • Returns
Free Shipping

Free shipping is available if you live in the continental United States and you spend $50 or more (before taxes are applied).

All US-address destined orders will be shipped via our choice of UPS Ground or FEDEX Ground, unless otherwise requested. Delivery times vary between 1 to 5 business days.

"Continental United States" refers to the 48 contiguous states and the District of Columbia, but excludes Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico or the other U.S. territories and military posts. For these regions, please contact us at 800.227.7713 (USA and Canada) or 913.608.8530 for an accurate quote, including shipping. English y español.

International Shipping

LEVEL5 Tools ships worldwide! To get a quote that includes accurate shipping for your region, call 800.227.7713 (USA and Canada) or 913.608.8530 . English y español.

To quote your order, we will need the following details:

  • First and Last Name
  • EXACT Shipping Address
  • Mobile Number
  • Email Address
  • A list of the tools you wish to purchase

Please note that your order will be transacted in US dollars and your credit card company or bank will perform the conversion to your native currency on your behalf.

METHOD OF SHIPMENT

All merchandise destined for outside the continental US will be shipped via air or ocean. Rates and delivery times for international parcel shipment will vary based on carrier, delivery method, and speed of shipment required. The customer is responsible for the freight charges and all invoices are prepaid before shipment.

DUTIES & CUSTOMS

Your country may charge additional fees in the form of duties, border clearing costs, taxes, etc. that would be in addition to the quote we are providing you. It is your responsibility to understand what these additional costs might be. Your country may hold your order at the border until you have paid them these additional fees. WE HIGHLY RECOMMEND you contact an international shipping broker in your country who can assist you with understanding any additional costs associated with importing your tools and can make the importation easy for you by handling the logistics and paperwork on your behalf.

Order Tracking

We’re as excited as you are to get your order in your hands. There are a few different ways to keep track of the status of your order:

ORDER HISTORY

Login to your LEVEL5 Tools account at LEVEL5Tools.com to check the status of your order from processing to shipping. Order history will also show you if any items have been shipped separately in the case of a multiple item order where an item was not in stock and could not be shipped with the rest of your order. Please note, if your order doesn’t qualify for free shipping, you will only be charged shipping one time for split orders.

EMAIL UPDATES

When your order status changes an email will be automatically sent to you. You can make sure this information reaches you in a timely manner by double-checking that you have entered your email address correctly at the time of order placement.

Also, if you believe you have not received an email from us, please have a look in your spam folder prior to contacting us. Sometimes our messages are diverted to this folder inadvertently.

SHIPMENT TRACKING

When your tools ship, your account will be updated to show the shipper’s tracking number associated with your order.

For orders shipped by FEDEX or UPS, you can easily keep an eye on your merchandise by visiting www.fedex.com or www.ups.com and entering the tracking number that we provide you via email.

Partial Shipments

On occasion, we may have to ship a partial order on a multiple item order where one product may not be in stock or may have to be custom-manufactured to your specifications. You will be able to view all partial shipments in the Order History section of your profile on LEVEL5Tools.com.

If you receive a shipment and believe an item is missing, please call us at toll-free at 866.562.4229 (local: 913.631.0804) Monday through Friday, between 8am and 4pm Central Standard Time. We will be able to assist in track down your missing your item without delay.

Returns

The LEVEL5 30-Day, “No-Hassle” Policy

We believe it is important that you have some time to evaluate the design, quality, fit and finish of your LEVEL5 tools before fully committing to their use. Therefore, if you aren’t 100% satisfied, you have a period of 30 days from purchase to return any UNUSED tools you've purchased directly from LEVEL5 Tools LLC. Click here to process your return.

Once your tools have been received in good order at our facility, you will receive your choice of a credit or refund of the original price. Please note that refunds must be applied against the same credit card you used to make the original purchase.

You will be responsible for any return shipping expenses. We recommend you insure your shipment with your shipping agent (FEDEX, UPS, USPS, etc.), as you are responsible for any damage to the tools during the return shipment. To assist with offsetting these return shipping costs, LEVEL5 will provide you with a one-time use coupon code for our website equal to the return shipping amount (a copy of the shipping receipt is required).

Process Your Return

Terms & Conditions

If you wish to return your LEVEL5 tools within the 30-day evaluation period:

  • The tools must be returned in the original packaging, including any internal bags, foam inserts, internal boxes, and/or shipping boxes - to ensure the tools are protected during delivery back to our facility.
  • The tools must be unused and undamaged, so they can be resold as new, in order to receive a full refund of the purchase price.
    • UNUSED TOOLS - Any unused tools received that are damaged in any way so that they cannot be resold as new will need to be refurbished. This requires us to charge you a 25% restocking fee.
    • USED TOOLS - Any used tools received will need to be cleaned of joint compound, refurbished and sold at a discount. We will charge you a 50% restocking fee OR return the used tools back to you if preferred. You will be responsible for paying any corresponding shipping charges if you wish to have the tools returned.
  • Any tools that are received damaged and cannot be refurbished and resold will discarded and will not qualify for a refund. You will have the option to have the tool(s) returned to you, but you will be responsible for paying any corresponding shipping charges

If you have any questions regarding this return policy, please reach out to us toll-free at 866.562.4229 (local: 913.631.0804).

The LEVEL5 30-Day, “No-Hassle” Policy
We believe it is important that you have some time to evaluate the design, quality, fit and finish of your LEVEL5 tools before fully committing to their use. Therefore, if you aren't 100% satisfied, you have a period of 30 days from purchase to return any UNUSED tools you've purchased directly from LEVEL5 Tools LLC. Click here to process your return.

Once your tools have been received in good order at our facility, you will receive your choice of a credit or refund of the original price. Please note that refunds must be applied against the same credit card you used to make the original purchase.

You will be responsible for any return shipping expenses. We recommend you insure your shipment with your shipping agent (FEDEX, UPS, USPS, etc.), as you are responsible for any damage to the tools during the return shipment. To assist with offsetting these return shipping costs, LEVEL5 will provide you with a one-time use coupon code for our website equal to the return shipping amount (a copy of the shipping receipt is required).

Process Your Return
Terms & Condition
If you wish to return your LEVEL5 tools within the 30-day evaluation period:
  • The tools must be returned in the original packaging, including any internal bags, foam inserts, internal boxes, and/or shipping boxes - to ensure the tools are protected during delivery back to our facility.
  • The tools must be unused and undamaged, so they can be resold as new, in order to receive a full refund of the purchase price.
    • UNUSED TOOLS - Any unused tools received that are damaged in any way so that they cannot be resold as new will need to be refurbished. This requires us to charge you a 25% restocking fee.
    • USED TOOLS - Any used tools received will need to be cleaned of joint compound, refurbished and sold at a discount. We will charge you a 50% restocking fee OR return the used tools back to you if preferred. You will be responsible for paying any corresponding shipping charges if you wish to have the tools returned.
  • Any tools that are received damaged and cannot be refurbished and resold will discarded and will not qualify for a refund. You will have the option to have the tool(s) returned to you, but you will be responsible for paying any corresponding shipping charges.
If you have any questions regarding this return policy, please reach out to us toll-free at 866.562.4229 (local: 913.631.0804).

<script>
    {{!--
        Check for modern browser features, and load polyfills if browser does not appear to support features
        we need.

            Polyfill approach is all or nothing - please import needed polyfills in /assets/js/polyfills.js

        Inspired by https://philipwalton.com/articles/loading-polyfills-only-when-needed/
            --}}
    function browserSupportsAllFeatures() {
        return window.Promise
            && window.fetch
            && window.URL
            && window.URLSearchParams
            && window.WeakMap
            // object-fit support
            && ('objectFit' in document.documentElement.style);
    }

    function loadScript(src) {
        var js = document.createElement('script');
        js.src = src;
        js.onerror = function () {
            console.error('Failed to load polyfill script ' + src);
        };
        document.head.appendChild(js);
    }

    if (!browserSupportsAllFeatures()) {
        loadScript('{{cdn 'assets/dist/theme-bundle.polyfills.js'}}');
    }
</script>

CORNERS CONQUERED.

Your choice in corner applicator tools comes down to convenience, preference, and job type. Here’s a breakdown of the key differences:

Corner Applicator: A 7” all-aluminum, corrosion resistant housing featuring a proprietary urethane wiper seal. The key benefits are:

  • Lightweight on the wall
  • Manual mud control for those who want it
  • Lower upfront cost
  • Easy to clean & maintain

MiniShot: A pressurized compound applicator that delivers mud without the manual pushing of a backplate. During the filling process, back pressure is created that seamlessly dispenses mud with an adjustable flow when pressed onto the wall. The key benefits are:

  • Very fast and smooth operation for larger projects
  • No pushing on the wall, when the Minishot is activated the flow nozzle ensures consistent coverage.
  • Holds significantly more mud, meaning fewer trips back and forth to the pump and longer runs across the wall.
  • Less fatigue over long days.

CORNER FINISHERS

All LEVEL5 corner finishers feature a precision-machined aluminum body, premium color anodizing for corrosion resistance, and a robotically welded frame for long-term reliability. This choice comes down to flexibility and budget.

Single 3” Finisher: The most versatile size for a corner finisher, letting you achieve a professional finish and save time by applying mud to both sides of inside corners.

3” & 3.5” Finishers: To minimize sanding and touch ups, this grouping of finishers offers added feathering capabilities to your set. Use the 3” finisher for the initial tape “glazing” coat, and the 3.5” finisher for the second fill coat. The larger finisher will ensure corners are feathered out.
